scientific_integrity: A self-contained binary carry-matrix proof establishes the all-length recurrence; finite enumeration is only corroborating evidence.
scientific_limitations: Fixed multiplier seven and unshifted complete dyadic blocks only. Not a theorem for arbitrary odd multipliers or for a nonzero normalized limiting correlation. A broad 2002 survey is not fully inspected, and earlier equivalent statements could be undiscovered.
title: A strictly positive dyadic parity correlation at the multiplier \(7\)
